review_comments.body:
I think my goal with this test was to actually perform an exhaustive evaluation.
While I agree listing the assertions in the expected value would be excessive, having the `process` attributes all be evaluated and checked would be useful.

It is a bit unorthodox perhaps, so I'll propose a comment.

```suggestion

# The goal of this test is to perform and check a complete evaluation of all options.
# Only filter out values that are truly infeasible to check, such as function values.
```

```suggestion
      # Technically we could check the presence of all assertions regardless,
      # But this would lead to unnecessary churn that duplicates coverage that
      # should be achieved in assertion-specific tests anyway.
      assertions = failures config.assertions;
```
